TARGET RANK 1 OF 5 — very humble BEGINNING, obvious large contrast from final. Original lower-left medicine shop becomes a narrow scratched rough plank table on two simple supports, plain wooden stool/chair at same cat location, one warm hanging lamp and modest bare corrugated shelter. Remove windchime. Preserve existing architecture, normal windows and harbor, tranquil early-stage simplicity. Cat remains small and working at basic notebook/mortar. This should visually read as ONE modest temporary worktable in an otherwise ordinary town, not a developed pharmacy.
